entries.reason: Weekly backstop. Active on five ranks; inactive on Diamond+ only, because its Bring The Boom text differs from the plan's precondition. The precondition (and the effective text on Bronze+ to Platinum+ and Paragon+) is the 1.16.4 packet correction 1.16.4-review2-121: 'Rad Rounds deals 50% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding. Rad Rounds explosion radius is 600u.' On those ranks Pred.gg 1.18 (version 170) now reads 'Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.' and the collector keeps the reviewed 50% text over it ('Verified official/reviewed field retained'). On Diamond+ the correction did not apply ('conflict: field unavailable'), so Diamond+ shows Pred.gg's 60% text, the plan waits there and the Official correction review notice names Bring The Boom. So Diamond+ is not carrying older text, as the 8 Nov strategy review described it; it carries the newer Pred.gg value, and the other ranks show the 1.16.4 value. Neither live official article (1.18, 1.17.2) mentions Bring The Boom, so no official text settles 50% versus 60%, and only official text may resolve a correction. The plan's reasoning (splash on Rad Rounds explosions) holds at either value, but changing the precondition would only move the mismatch to the other five ranks. Left unchanged: active on five ranks, waiting on Diamond+.
entries.limitation: Pred.gg's 60% is unconfirmed by any official note; the 1.16.4 correction's 50% may be out of date after 1.18. Resolving it needs official text or an owner decision on that correction. Diamond+ carry sample for Drongo: 1 game. No in-game test.
